rawContent: Two days later and this is still on my mind. As an educator at @Rutgers_Newark, I have seen many cases of plagiarism, but only 1 or 2 ever have ever escalated beyond the department. So where does that leave @Rutgers_Newark and @RutgersU in terms of #metoo? #MeTooSTEM

For 2019, I am expecting a new contract: one that values grad labor, that ends exploitation of adjunct faculty, eliminates price hikes on tuition, supports racial equity & justice, as well as a scandal-free athletics year & tackling of #MeToo issues at RU.

For starters. .@ruaaup

If you enjoy 1920s British mysteries, the recent perspective shift from the #MeToo movement makes the Violet Carlyle Cozy Historical Mysteries* series more realistic & refreshing if don't mind somewhat sophomoric storytelling (along with some editing issues).

*Still very white. https://t.co/rjHOZdFt0I
